title: How do you type arrays and objects in TypeScript?
expectedConcepts: Object type annotations specifying keys and values
hints: How do you say "an array of numbers" in TypeScript?
What error occurs if you try to put a string into a number[] array?

codingExercise.instruction: Define an interface Movie with id (number), title (string), and genres (array of strings).
codingExercise.expectedOutput: interface Movie with id: number; title: string; genres: string[];
